facts: The sine rule for a side is $\dfrac{a}{\sin A}=\dfrac{b}{\sin B}=\dfrac{c}{\sin C}$: each side over the sine of its opposite angle.
The longest side is opposite the largest angle, and the shortest side is opposite the smallest angle.

Put the unknown side on top: $\dfrac{x}{\sin(\text{its angle})}=\dfrac{\text{known side}}{\sin(\text{its angle})}$, then $x=\dfrac{\text{known side}\times\sin(\text{unknown's angle})}{\sin(\text{known angle})}$.
You need a complete **opposite pair** — a side and its opposite angle — plus the angle opposite the unknown side.
If the angle opposite a side you need is not marked, find it first with the angle sum: the three angles add to $180^{\circ}$.
Keep the full calculator value until the last line, then round to the accuracy asked.
steps: Find any needed angle using the angle sum of the triangle
Write the two relevant fractions of the sine rule, unknown side on top
Substitute the known side and angles
Multiply to make the unknown side the subject, then evaluate

development.solution_text:
The $13$ cm side is opposite the unmarked top angle, so find that angle first.
$180^{\circ}-48^{\circ}-57^{\circ}=75^{\circ}$
$\dfrac{x}{\sin 48^{\circ}}=\dfrac{13}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$x=\dfrac{13\sin 48^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$\approx 10.0\text{ cm}$

The $9.4$ m side is opposite the unmarked top angle, so find it first.
$180^{\circ}-73^{\circ}-35^{\circ}=72^{\circ}$
$\dfrac{x}{\sin 35^{\circ}}=\dfrac{9.4}{\sin 72^{\circ}}$
$x=\dfrac{9.4\sin 35^{\circ}}{\sin 72^{\circ}}$
$\approx 5.7\text{ m}$

The $6.8$ m side is opposite the $75^{\circ}$ angle, and $x$ is opposite the $46^{\circ}$ angle.
$\dfrac{x}{\sin 46^{\circ}}=\dfrac{6.8}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$x=\dfrac{6.8\sin 46^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$\approx 5.1\text{ m}$

The $9$ m side is opposite the $60^{\circ}$ angle, and $x$ is opposite the $50^{\circ}$ angle.
$\dfrac{x}{\sin 50^{\circ}}=\dfrac{9}{\sin 60^{\circ}}$
$x=\dfrac{9\sin 50^{\circ}}{\sin 60^{\circ}}$
$\approx 8.0\text{ m}$

$QR$ is opposite $\angle P$, so pair the $85$ m side ($PQ$) with the angle opposite it, $\angle R$.
$\angle R=180^{\circ}-68^{\circ}-65^{\circ}=47^{\circ}$
$\dfrac{QR}{\sin 68^{\circ}}=\dfrac{85}{\sin 47^{\circ}}$
$QR=\dfrac{85\sin 68^{\circ}}{\sin 47^{\circ}}$
$\approx 107.8\text{ m}$

$BC$ is opposite $\angle A$, so pair the $1.4$ km leg ($AB$) with the angle opposite it, $\angle C$.
$\angle C=180^{\circ}-74^{\circ}-66^{\circ}=40^{\circ}$
$\dfrac{BC}{\sin 74^{\circ}}=\dfrac{1.4}{\sin 40^{\circ}}$
$BC=\dfrac{1.4\sin 74^{\circ}}{\sin 40^{\circ}}$
$\approx 2.09\text{ km}$

mastery.solution_text:
$AC$ is opposite $\angle B$, so find $\angle B$ first.
$\angle B=180^{\circ}-57^{\circ}-48^{\circ}=75^{\circ}$
$AB$ is opposite $\angle C$:
$AB=\dfrac{2\sin 48^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$\approx 1.5388\ldots\text{ km}$
$BC$ is opposite $\angle A$:
$BC=\dfrac{2\sin 57^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}}$
$\approx 1.7366\ldots\text{ km}$
$AB+BC+CA\approx 1.5388+1.7366+2$
$\approx 5.28\text{ km}$

$XY$ is opposite $\angle Z$, so find $\angle Z$ first.
$\angle Z=180^{\circ}-82^{\circ}-39^{\circ}=59^{\circ}$
$YZ$ is opposite $\angle X$:
$YZ=\dfrac{64\sin 82^{\circ}}{\sin 59^{\circ}}$
$\approx 73.9\text{ m}$
$XZ$ is opposite $\angle Y$:
$XZ=\dfrac{64\sin 39^{\circ}}{\sin 59^{\circ}}$
$\approx 47.0\text{ m}$

$BC$ is opposite $\angle A$. The $3.2$ km leg $AB$ is opposite $\angle C$, so find $\angle C$ first.
$\angle C=180^{\circ}-40^{\circ}-112^{\circ}=28^{\circ}$
$\dfrac{BC}{\sin 40^{\circ}}=\dfrac{3.2}{\sin 28^{\circ}}$
$BC=\dfrac{3.2\sin 40^{\circ}}{\sin 28^{\circ}}$
$\approx 4.38\text{ km}$
